recommended_certs.rationale: GPEN で侵入テストの基礎を固めてから、敵対者エミュレーション/C2 構築に踏み込む GRTP へ進むのが SANS の正攻法。
OSCP の手作業侵入経験を前提に、Red Team 計画~C2 運用までを評価する GRTP に進むと体系化が進む。

plus.note: プランニング~C2~実行まで End-to-End Red Team を評価する数少ない上位資格。

minus.note: 2024 年公開で求人要件としての浸透はこれから。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: CyberLive tasks across planning, command and control, and execution support professional red-team delivery at three years; recent introduction and limited market uptake restrain expert recognition.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: CyberLive tasks spanning planning, C2 and execution provide a strong professional red-team hiring signal. The three-year profile fits delivery responsibility, while limited uptake and no recorded external accreditation temper expert-level inference.

alex-novak.rationale: Recorded CyberLive tasks span red-team planning, C2 and execution at a three-year level. That end-to-end practical evidence supports professional delivery despite limited recognition from its recent release.
